items.description: Confirm to the charterer that the 33.5 hours from the failed inspection on 8 Oct at 14:00 to the pass on 10 Oct at 02:00 will be treated as off-hire and that the cost of the hold washing chemicals of USD 2,300 will be borne.
Prepare a claim for the off-hire period of 33.5 hours due to the failed inspection and document the associated costs, including the USD 2,300 for the hold washing chemicals.
